title: 包裹显示送达却没收到，打电话英语怎么说？
summary: 物流显示 delivered 但门口没有包裹，别慌。这篇教你打电话给客服查件的完整说法。

phrases.en: It says delivered, but I didn't get it.
phrases.zh: 显示已送达，但我没收到。

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.en: Hi, my package hasn't arrived yet. The tracking number is 9400 1234.
dialogue.zh: 你好，我的包裹还没到。追踪号是 9400 1234。

dialogue.speaker: Agent
dialogue.en: Let me check... It shows delivered yesterday at 2 pm.
dialogue.zh: 我查一下……显示昨天下午 2 点已送达。

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.en: But I didn't get it. It says delivered, but there's nothing at my door.
dialogue.zh: 但我没收到。显示送达了，可门口什么都没有。

dialogue.speaker: Agent
dialogue.en: It might have been misdelivered. Did you check with your neighbors?
dialogue.zh: 可能是送错地址了。你问过邻居吗？

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.en: Not yet. Can you open an investigation?
dialogue.zh: 还没。能帮我立案调查吗？

dialogue.speaker: Agent
dialogue.en: Of course. We'll contact the driver and get back to you in 2 days.
dialogue.zh: 当然。我们会联系快递员，2 天内回复你。

seoTitle: 包裹没收到英文怎么说？
seoDescription: 包裹显示送达却没收到怎么办？本文教你打电话给快递客服查件的英语说法，附完整对话。
